pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: The knight can parry: a qualifying hit triggers its response state and is rejected. It also has a brief protected attack segment. After the parry sound, stop the combo and leave the frontal sector; retry after the response motion.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Knight's Sword Blade Half. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
